user.title: Water bill
user.description: Pick the index sensor of your meter, for instance « Compteur eau - Volume total » from the wM-Bus meter. One bill per meter.

tarif.title: Tariff source
tarif.description: Where does the water price come from?

prereglage.title: Your local authority's tariff
prereglage.description: Tariffs taken from official decisions. Your town is missing? See the contribution guide in the repository.

data.assainissement: Connected to the public sewer (collective sanitation)

prix_fixe.title: Fixed price
prix_fixe.description: Average price per m³ including VAT and subscription (from your last bill, for instance).

releve.title: Last meter reading
releve.description: Copy the date and index of your last bill: the cost is computed from that reading.

error.unite: The index must be in m³ or L.
error.state_class: The sensor must be a cumulative index (state_class total_increasing or total).
error.index_incoherent: This index is above the current meter index.
error.date_future: The date is in the future.
